349.title: 7e VERIFY: real upload on the W7 preview, confirm the vision-latency series lands
349.note: Verification, not a code change — no file contention. On the critical path: gates 350, which gates 351. Start it first. Needs Modal (unblocked since 2026-07-26).
349.result: VERDICT YES — wired end to end. 36 real vision calls on a preview with Modal live; series in VictoriaMetrics and read back through Grafana own datasource. p50 8437.5ms / p95 49500ms / p99 57900ms, +Inf=0. Tail is cold starts: warm (n=30) median (5s,8s], p95 (15s,30s], max <=30s; cold (n=6) reaches 60s. Falsified the "~3-8s" estimate at plugins/stacks.ex:41 (only 18/36 <= 8s).
349.carried_to_350: NO evidence beyond 60s — all 36 returned 200, so the :exception path contributed zero samples; a call slower than the deadline never emits :stop. The count of 210s give-ups needs an :exception counter that does not exist. Also: VisionLatencyTest:138-146 ties the top finite bucket to receive_timeout_ms/0, so retuning the timeout without moving the bucket reddens it by design (guards the 2026-04-20 incident).

374.title: 7b Failure-copy sweep (upload / 429 / W-10 settings / double-send)
374.result: Built Util/FailureCopy.elm and gave six upload causes their own copy. Fixed TWO upstream defects that made the copy unreachable: (a) Api.PollStatus decoded SSE "timeout" to Rejected with a null reason, so a reader the pipeline never answered for was told their photo was unreadable; (b) UploadInitialised/R2PutCompleted error legs stored a LITERAL Failure Http.NetworkError, so a 429, a 413 and a dropped connection were the same value. Also fixed #369 req 5 (the "Invalid email or password" catch-all for any status). For 429: elm/http collapses non-2xx to BadStatus Int — the status survives but HEADERS DO NOT — so it moved four :auth endpoints onto expectStringResponse to read retry-after. waitPhrase rounds UP (61s -> "2 minutes") because being sent back early produces a second 429; HTTP-date retry-after deliberately returns Nothing rather than a guess.
374.best_finding: PROBE 9 REDDENED NOTHING, and that was the point. Reintroducing the exact UploadInitialised defect left all 1637 tests green — because UploadInitialised takes an opaque `File` that no Elm test can construct, so nothing CAN drive that leg. It added coverage on the sibling R2PutCompleted leg (9b reddens) and wrote the limitation into the test rather than claiming coverage it lacks.
374.also_fixed: e2e mockPollRejected/mockPollNotABook sent is_duplicate: null; the decoder requires a bool (#328) and StreamEvent discards undecodable frames, so both specs sat on the spinner until timeout. ALREADY FAILING on the integration branch before this diff.

350.title: 7g Vision client gives up 90s before Modal does
350.result: receive_timeout_ms = modal_function_timeout_ms (300000) + transport_slack_ms (30000) = 330000. REJECTED the lead framing of sizing from #349 percentiles, with a better argument: this is not a latency budget but a TRANSPORT LIVENESS BACKSTOP derived from the server deadline. When the timer fires there are only two worlds — before Modal deadline (an answer may still come, abandoning buys nothing and costs a retry) or after (Modal already gave up, socket dead, retry is right). Only the second is actionable. Declined to cut toward the measured distribution because all 36 samples are calls that FINISHED — the histogram is conditional on a response and cannot show its own tail — and queue wait (~120s on a contended A10G) was never exercised.
350.added_in_scope: the :exception counter, rather than filing it: raising a deadline whose only failure mode is invisible would be unfalsifiable. reason_class="timeout" going non-zero is the one observation that says 330s is wrong.
350.cross_language_gate: @modal_function_timeout_ms is checked against modal_app.py by parsing the decorator — editing timeout=300 now reddens mix test. A gate over a boundary nothing previously covered.
